moduleResolve: First failure is retried; 2 resolves/1 source.
moduleSource: Failure is cached; 1 resolve/1 source, second failing call retains first diagnostic.
nullVersusEmpty: Null message omits cause line; empty message retains IOException: followed by a space and LF.
